status: Authored test specification only; NOT executed against the chatbot.
rules: Adapt probes to actual replies; do not send events out of context.
Phrase groups are candidates, not global action labels.
Approved facts/policies are the oracle; current implementation is not automatically correct.
Use sandbox synthetic fixtures only; backend outbound messages must be intercepted.
UI/fault placeholders are harness actions, not patient messages.
Missing setup, policy or evidence is not PASS.

cases.title: Referral yes
cases.patient_probe_or_event: ja
cases.expected_behaviour: Update referral only; do not submit.

cases.title: Chat continuation
cases.anchor: Question offers preparation here in chat
cases.patient_probe_or_event: yep
cases.expected_behaviour: Continue chat; ask next missing item, no channel loop.

cases.title: Field confirmation
cases.anchor: Only the synthetic email is being checked
cases.patient_probe_or_event: genau
cases.expected_behaviour: Confirm email, not authorization for the whole request.

cases.title: Clear send authorization
cases.anchor: Current complete summary and sole active send question
cases.patient_probe_or_event: ja bitte abschicken
cases.expected_behaviour: Exactly one sandbox request; truthful verified result, not confirmed appointment.

cases.title: Stale authorization
cases.anchor: Send question interrupted by a price question and answer
cases.patient_probe_or_event: ah ok danke
cases.expected_behaviour: Acknowledge price information; do not answer stale send question automatically.

cases.title: Ambiguous yes
cases.anchor: User is offered form OR chat
cases.patient_probe_or_event: ja; then hier mit dir after clarification
cases.expected_behaviour: Clarify which option once, then advance.

cases.title: German doch
cases.anchor: Bot asks Sie haben keine Verordnung?
cases.patient_probe_or_event: doch, hab eine
cases.expected_behaviour: Record that patient HAS a referral.

cases.title: Form refusal
cases.patient_probe_or_event: kein formular bitte; hier passt
cases.expected_behaviour: Reject form only; continue chat.

cases.title: Pause
cases.patient_probe_or_event: not now; give me a sec; ok carry on
cases.expected_behaviour: Pause and resume without sending, deleting or resetting.

cases.title: Day-only rejection
cases.anchor: Summary has wrong day but other data correct
cases.patient_probe_or_event: nein nur der tag stimmt nicht; donnerstag nicht dienstag
cases.expected_behaviour: Correct day only; preserve other fields.

cases.title: Qualified affirmative
cases.patient_probe_or_event: ja aber noch nicht senden, erst die mail ändern
cases.expected_behaviour: Hold sending, change email, show current summary.

cases.title: Hesitant response
cases.patient_probe_or_event: maybe; show me again first
cases.expected_behaviour: Do not submit; show summary and clarify.

cases.title: Restore older value
cases.patient_probe_or_event: doch wieder wie zuerst, donnerstag
cases.expected_behaviour: Restore Thursday, not both dates.

cases.title: Ordinal reference
cases.anchor: Two actual options shown in recorded order
cases.patient_probe_or_event: das zweite bitte
cases.expected_behaviour: Resolve actual second option, not a hard-coded meaning.

cases.title: Ambiguous referent
cases.anchor: Phone and day both discussed immediately before
cases.patient_probe_or_event: das bitte ändern
cases.expected_behaviour: Ask which item; do not guess or wipe both.

cases.title: Older email
cases.anchor: Email supplied five turns ago, no replacement
cases.patient_probe_or_event: nimm die mail von vorher
cases.expected_behaviour: Use unambiguous earlier address, not another session.

cases.title: Change time only
cases.patient_probe_or_event: same day but after 6 instead
cases.expected_behaviour: Keep Thursday; change to after 18:00, no availability claim.

cases.title: FAQ detour
cases.patient_probe_or_event: wie komm ich zu euch?; ok zurück zum termin
cases.expected_behaviour: Use approved location facts; resume pending field, not restart.

cases.title: Older question answered
cases.anchor: Referral question interrupted by hours discussion
cases.patient_probe_or_event: wegen deiner frage vorher: verordnung hab ich
cases.expected_behaviour: Attach answer to earlier referral question.

cases.title: Hypothetical yes
cases.patient_probe_or_event: wenn ich später ja schreibe, wird das dann abgeschickt?
cases.expected_behaviour: Explain only; do not submit.

cases.title: Austrian colloquial

cases.title: Borrowed acknowledgement

cases.title: Receipt vs chat language

cases.title: ASCII and casing

cases.title: Dictation correction

cases.title: Fragmented email

cases.title: All data at once
cases.patient_probe_or_event: hi {{NAME}}, neu, mail {{EMAIL}}, nummer {{PHONE}}, rücken, do ab 17

cases.title: Unusual proper name

cases.title: Phone refusal

cases.title: Uncertain patient status

cases.title: Another person is patient

cases.patient_probe_or_event: auch für meinen mann, gleiche mail

cases.title: Unknown optional field

cases.title: Relative date

cases.title: Forget one detail

cases.title: Two questions

cases.title: False confirmed booking

cases.title: Repeated send

cases.title: Change vs new request
cases.anchor: Recent sandbox request matching normalized contact
cases.patient_probe_or_event: tag ist falsch; nur ändern, keinen zweiten termin
